notes.title: Day 3: Patch 1: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixes


 Scanner will now more accurately depict where the monster is.


Update


 The ending should be easier reached with fewer button presses


NEWS

Massive update is coming soon for a better experience and also will include new content!

notes.title: Day 2: Patch 1:
notes.notes:
Area changes:
[olist]
 The night vision scanner in the Sector A is now permanent and does not have a cool down
making it easier and less frustrating.
 Turbines are easier to turn and less confusing.
 When the monster uses the vents it wont kill you if you are standing under it.
[/olist]

Quality Change:
Noise meter added to track the amount of noise you are making
